query: RTX 5080 Super RTX 5070 Ti Super launch 2026 GPU lineup prices
answer: According to the sources, the RTX 5080 Super is rumored to launch in October 2026 with a price range of $1,099 to $1,199, featuring 24GB of GDDR7 VRAM, 10,752 CUDA cores, and a 360W power draw. The RTX 5070 Ti Super is also expected to launch in October 2026 with a price range of $799 to $849, offering 24GB of GDDR7 VRAM, 8,960 CUDA cores, and a 350W power draw. These prices are based on unofficial leaks and rumors, with no official confirmation from Nvidia.

results.title: GPU Prices in 2026: The Complete Buy-or-Wait Guide
results.content:
Here is the gap between the launch MSRP and what you actually pay in July 2026. NVIDIA’s RTX 5070 launched at CA$769 (US$549) and now starts around CA$911 (US$650). The RTX 5070 Ti launched at CA$1,050 (US$749) and trades between CA$1,261 (US$900) and CA$1,822 (US$1,300), with typical listings in the CA$1,401 (US$1,000) to CA$1,682 (US$1,200) band and marketplace outliers pushing past CA$1,962 (US$1,400). The RTX 5080 left the factory at CA$1,400 (US$999) and now runs CA$1,822 (US$1,300) to [...] GPU prices are 18% to 74% over MSRP because AI demand made memory scarce, and the fix is years out. The RTX 5080 that launched at CA$1,400 (US$999) now costs CA$1,822 (US$1,300) to CA$2,032 (US$1,450), while the RTX 5070 Ti sits near CA$1,401 (US$1,000) against a CA$1,050 (US$749) sticker. AMD’s RX 9070 XT is the current value floor near CA$839 (US$599), but a 10% to 15% AMD increase is landing this half. [...] by Ryan Billings

GPU prices in 2026 have quietly detached from the numbers on the launch slides, and the GeForce RTX 5080 is the cleanest example. It shipped at CA$1,400 (US$999). In July 2026 you will pay somewhere between CA$1,822 (US$1,300) and CA$2,032 (US$1,450) for the same card, in the same box, with the same silicon. Nothing about the product got better. The memory soldered around the chip got more expensive, and that cost landed on your invoice.

results.title: RTX 5000: release date, price and specs for the whole range
results.content:
In short: NVIDIA’s RTX 5000 series (RTX 50), Blackwell architecture, was announced at CES on 6 January 2025. The RTX 5090 and 5080 launched on 30 January 2025, followed by the RTX 5070 Ti (20 February), 5070 (5 March), 5060 Ti (16 April), 5060 (19 May) and 5050 (1 July 2025). US launch prices: from $249 (RTX 5050) to $1,999 (RTX 5090). Their big new feature is DLSS 4’s Multi Frame Generation, which can generate up to three images per calculated frame, six with DLSS 4.5 since March 2026. The RTX [...] In the US at launch: $249 for the RTX 5050, $299 for the 5060, $379 and $429 for the 5060 Ti 8 and 16GB, $549 for the 5070, $749 for the 5070 Ti, $999 for the 5080 and $1,999 for the 5090. European prices are higher, and the 2026 memory shortage weighs on the pricing.

### Are the RTX 5000 made using 3nm?

No. Contrary to 2024 rumours, the consumer Blackwell chips are made by TSMC in 4N, a variant of 5nm.
